subject: Orchid Labs — Security questionnaire kickoff & clarifying asks
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@orchidlabs.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-12T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Orchid Labs — Security questionnaire kickoff & clarifying asks

Hi Alex — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can kick off the vendor security questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ) and map evidence: 

Summary from our call
- Use case: Orchid will embed Redwood inference for anonymized document summarization in your customer workflows.
- Expected traffic: modest to start (burstable), may scale to 2k reqs/min in Q2.
- Data: primarily metadata and customer content; please confirm PHI scope below.

Clarifying security/compliance questions
1) SOC 2: can you confirm whether Orchid has a SOC 2 report (Type II)? If yes, what is the report date and scope?
2) Data residency & GDPR: is any EU customer data stored or processed in EU-only environments?
3) HIPAA/PHI: does Orchid handle PHI that would require a BAA? If so, can you share a short description of which workflows touch PHI?
4) Questionnaire preference: do you want the SIG Lite + CAIQ or a custom vendor questionnaire? We can accept SIG Lite (fast) or full SIG/CAIQ for deeper review.

Attached: short Redwood SOC 2 summary and a prefill template that speeds the SIG process. If you can assign a technical contact to fill the prefill (xlsx) it would shorten turnaround.

Proposed next steps
- You assign a technical/contact to fill the prefill template by EOD Monday (2026-12-14).
- We run SIG Lite + CAIQ in parallel (3 week target for prefill + evidence collection).
- If PHI/BAA required, we add BAA execution to the MAP — we can share a standard BAA and include legal contacts.

If this looks good I’ll open the HubSpot deal task and add an evidence tracker with owners (cc’ing Lauren for evidence coordination).

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

[attachment: redwood_soc2_summary_2026-08.pdf (SOC2 summary)]
[attachment: orchid_prefill_template.xlsx (prefill template for SIG/CAIQ)]

From: Alex Chen <alex@orchidlabs.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Orchid Labs Security <security@orchidlabs.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Orchid Labs — Security questionnaire kickoff & clarifying asks

Thanks Marcus — great to chat. Quick answers below and next steps from our side.

1) SOC 2: Orchid has a SOC 2 Type II report dated 2025-09 (controls relevant to cloud services). We can share the SOC 2 summary and the full report under an NDA if needed.
2) Data residency: we host mainly in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Most customers are US-based; a small subset have EU-only requirements.
3) HIPAA/PHI: we do process limited PHI for two customers (redacted pipelines). We do require a BAA for those integrations.
4) Questionnaire preference: we’d like SIG Lite + CAIQ answered; if you prefer a single combined workflow we can do that.

Technical contact: Priya Rao (priya@orchidlabs.com), Head of Security Engineering, will own the prefill. She’s cc’d on this thread.

Two asks from us:
- Can you confirm Redwood’s standard timeline for SIG + evidence collection once prefill is returned?
- Does Redwood sign a BAA? If yes, please send draft and legal contact.

Alex Chen
Head of Partnerships, Orchid Labs
alex@orchidlabs.com

Date: 2026-12-13T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Orchid Labs — Security questionnaire kickoff & clarifying asks

Appreciate the quick replies, Alex (and welcome Priya). A few confirmations and proposed timing from our side: 

- Redwood does execute BAAs for customers and will also sign a limited BAA for vendor scenarios when PHI is in scope. I’ll loop Legal if you want us to send a draft. Our legal contact is Lauren Bishop (cc’d).
- Typical SIG Lite + CAIQ flow: prefill returned by vendor -> Redwood security performs a lightweight review (3 business days) -> evidence requests issued for gaps (1–2 weeks depending on owner responsiveness). For a full SIG/CAIQ + evidence collection we budget 2–3 weeks.
- Data residency: we can route EU customer processing to our eu-west region if needed; happy to document architecture for those flows.

Priya: helpful if you can:
- Fill the prefill template and return in the next 48 hours if possible.
- Confirm which customer workflows process PHI (high level is fine).
- Point to any existing artifacts (SOC 2 summary, encryption architecture, key management docs) you can share.

I’ll open a HubSpot ticket and create a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with owners and milestones. Proposed MAP milestones:
- Pre-fill returned (Priya) — target 2026-12-14
- Initial Redwood review complete — target 2026-12-17
- Evidence requests sent / BAA draft circulated — target 2026-12-20

If Priya prefers we can set a short call tomorrow to walk the prefill.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai

Thanks Marcus — Priya here. I’ll take ownership of the prefill and have initial answers back by EOD 2026-12-14. A few quick notes: 

- We can do SIG Lite + CAIQ; I’ll prioritize the SIG Lite answers first and then the CAIQ spreadsheet.
- PHI: two customer connectors ingest limited PHI fields (name, date of birth, diagnostic codes). I’ll flag those sections in the prefill.
- Evidence: I can attach our SOC 2 summary and key architecture diagrams. I can also pull the full SOC 2 report if you require it under NDA.
- BAA: please send your standard BAA to legal@orchidlabs.com and I’ll route it to our counsel.

I’ll upload the completed prefill to the Drive link once ready and ping here when it’s posted. If Redwood wants to run an expedited review, I’m available for a 30m sync tomorrow morning (2026-12-15 09:00–11:00 PT).

Priya Rao
